versions.subject: Missing Qbot rules
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith: \reg.exe
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows Defender\Exclusions\Paths\'
        - 'HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Microsoft Antimalware\Exclusions\Paths'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'ADD '
        - '/t '
        - 'REG_DWORD '
        - '/v '
        - '/d '
        - '0'
condition: selection
versions.spl: Image="*\\reg.exe" CommandLine IN ("*HKLM\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows Defender\\Exclusions\\Paths\\*", "*HKLM\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Microsoft Antimalware\\Exclusions\\Paths*") CommandLine="*ADD *" CommandLine="*/t *" CommandLine="*REG_DWORD *" CommandLine="*/v *" CommandLine="*/d *" CommandLine="*0*"
